headword: {苦虫|にがむし}を{噛|か}み{潰|つぶ}したよう
reading: にがむしをかみつぶしたよう
gloss: looking sour; bitter-faced; looking extremely displeased

definitions.gloss: looking sour; bitter-faced; looking extremely displeased
definitions.explanation: An idiomatic expression describing a facial expression of extreme displeasure, irritation, or bitterness, as if one had bitten down on something intolerably bitter.

examples.japanese: {苦虫|にがむし}を{噛|か}み{潰|つぶ}したような⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He had a sour expression on his face.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、{苦虫|にがむし}を{噛|か}み{潰|つぶ}したような⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧になった。
examples.english: Upon hearing the report, the department head's expression turned sour.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{負|ま}けた→負ける：01134_makeru⟧⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{苦虫|にがむし}を{噛|か}み{潰|つぶ}したような⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{記者|きしゃ}{会見|かいけん}→記者会見：19954_kishakaiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{臨|のぞ}んだ→臨む：29038_nozomu⟧。
examples.english: Having lost the match, the coach faced the press conference with a grimly bitter expression.

notes:
Literally "as if one had crushed a bitter bug in one's teeth." {苦虫|にがむし} is not a real insect — it is an imaginary creature used only in this idiom to evoke an intensely bitter taste. The expression vividly captures the tightened lips and furrowed brow of someone deeply displeased.

USAGE:
Almost always used in the pattern {苦虫|にがむし}を{噛|か}み{潰|つぶ}したような + noun (especially ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ or ⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧). Describes suppressed displeasure — the person is unhappy but not shouting or crying; instead, the emotion shows silently in their face.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {苦虫|にがむし}を{噛|か}み{潰|つぶ}したような⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧: a bitter, sour face
- {苦虫|にがむし}を{噛|か}み{潰|つぶ}したような⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧: a displeased expression

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{渋|しぶ}い→渋い：06820_shibui⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧: a sour face; a reluctant look — less extreme; can imply reluctance rather than displeasure
- ⟦{不機嫌|ふきげん}→不機嫌：17453_fukigen⟧な⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧: an ill-tempered face — more direct, less vivid
- {仏頂面|ぶっちょうづら}: a sulky face; scowl — implies stubbornness and refusal to engage
